ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Every change to the merchant's balance, newest first.
ledger.loadFailed: The ledger could not be loaded
ledger.empty: No ledger lines yet. COD credits, fees and payouts appear here.

payout.title: Pay out {{name}}
payout.description: The merchant is owed {{balance}}. Send the wire first, then record it here with the bank's reference.
payout.referenceNote: Recording the same reference again never pays twice. Paying the whole balance also marks the merchant's issued invoices as paid.
payout.repeated: Reference {{reference}} was already recorded. Nothing new was paid.

errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero with two decimals, e.g. 120.00.
errors.wireReference: Use 4–40 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
errors.notFound: This merchant isn't in this company.
errors.exceedsBalance: That is more than the merchant is owed, so nothing was recorded.
errors.referenceReused: This reference was already used for a different amount.
errors.unknown: The payout could not be recorded. Try again.

cashHandover.title: Cash handover
cashHandover.description: Count the cash a driver hands in and record it against their delivered parcels.
cashHandover.waiting: Delivered parcels waiting for their cash
cashHandover.empty: This driver has no delivered parcels waiting for a handover.
cashHandover.repeated: Reference {{reference}} was already recorded. Nothing new was recorded.
cashHandover.tipDescription: The cash must match the parcels exactly. Recording it credits each merchant and clears their pending COD. Using the same reference again never records twice.

errors.cash: Enter the amount counted with two decimals, e.g. 120.00.
errors.reference: Use 4–40 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
errors.pendingTooLow: A merchant's pending COD is lower than these parcels' cash, so nothing was recorded. Record their delivery first.
errors.driverNotFound: This driver isn't in this company.
errors.parcelsNotEligible: Some of these parcels were already settled or changed. Reload the page and count again.
errors.referenceReused: This reference was used for a different handover. Enter a new reference.
errors.unknown: The handover could not be recorded. Try again.

cashHandover.selection: Selected parcels: {{selected}} (maximum {{maximum}}). Record any remaining parcels in a separate handover.
cashHandover.driversLoadFailed: The driver list could not be loaded.
cashHandover.retryExact: The result is unknown. Retry the same reference, cash amount and parcels to confirm whether it was recorded.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Statements of the delivery fees on a merchant's delivered parcels. The fees are already taken from the balance at the COD handover, so an invoice never moves money.
invoices.loadFailed: The invoices could not be loaded
invoices.empty: No invoices yet. Generate one to bill a period.

generate.title: Invoice {{name}}
generate.description: Bills the delivery fee of every parcel delivered in the period that is not on an invoice yet. The last day is included.
generate.note: The invoice is saved as a draft. Generating it never changes the merchant's balance.

detail.title: Invoice
detail.loadFailed: The invoice could not be loaded
detail.issueNote: Issuing sets the due date 14 days from today. It never changes the merchant's balance.

errors.badPeriod: The last day must be on or after the first day.
errors.notFound: This merchant isn't in this company.
errors.nothingToBill: Nothing to bill in that period. Every delivered parcel with a fee is already on an invoice, or there are none. If you just generated one, it is in the list.
errors.unknown: The invoice could not be created. Try again.
errors.notDraft: This invoice was already issued, or it is not a draft any more.
errors.invoiceNotFound: This invoice isn't in this company.
errors.issueUnknown: The invoice could not be issued. Try again.
